behavior: A brief without a fallback nonce, or with only an old nonce, is refused with 'freshness anchor'; a semantically identical contract reserialized by the current serializer is refused with 'changed' because its immutable bytes differ.
failure_caught: A recovery that accepts an old or nonce-less brief (replaying evidence from another result) or compares contracts semantically, so a rewritten contract still authenticates the fallback.
criticality_reason: The freshness nonce binds the frozen evidence to the current result and the contract digest binds it to the exact bytes (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:165-225).
signal_reason: Two brief variants error with the freshness-anchor message (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:453-455) and the reserialized contract errors with 'changed' (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:466-467).
uniqueness_reason: The branch at crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:124-163: distinct from the missing-original and marker cases; the only sibling asserting the brief nonce is nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime%3A%3Adelegation_fallback_files|canonical_reporting_and_publication_revisions_must_still_match_the_capture|default, which varies the canonical evidence instead.
fidelity_reason: Real brief/contract files rewritten on a real temp directory and the production validate_capture_files path (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:165-225).
recommendation_reason: Two independent freshness/byte refusals on real files.

behavior: Eighteen context fields (identity instance/attempt/contract/run/session/controller epoch, result version, binding provider/invocation/conversation/generation, control epoch/human revision/owner Human and Uncertain/attribution flag/both barrier kinds) each make validate_capture fail, as does a replacement server lifetime on the author.
failure_caught: A captured attribution surviving any reporting or control change, so evidence captured under one owner/binding is published after the human took control or the child rebound.
criticality_reason: The capture is only valid for the exact context and author that produced it; any drift is a different owner (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:70-122).
signal_reason: Eighteen mutations each error through validate_capture, plus the server-lifetime replacement (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:511-518).
uniqueness_reason: The branch at crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:70-122: one of three validate_capture families; the distinct input here is the fallback context, whereas nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime%3A%3Adelegation_fallback_files|canonical_reporting_and_publication_revisions_must_still_match_the_capture|default varies the canonical evidence and nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime%3A%3Adelegation_fallback_files|matching_canonical_evidence_cannot_describe_a_different_context_or_valid_publication|default the evidence-versus-context relation.
fidelity_reason: Calls the production validate_capture against a constructed capture; no file is read on this path (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:70-122).
recommendation_reason: Eighteen-field context matrix with one author mismatch.

behavior: A replacement author epoch, producer, parent or parent_run each makes validate_capture fail even with the original context and evidence.
failure_caught: Captured workflow provenance authorising a new parent or a new source producer, i.e. a different owner reusing the child's fallback.
criticality_reason: Authority equality at crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:70-122 ties the capture to one parent, producer and lifetime.
uniqueness_reason: The branch at crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:70-122: distinct from nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime%3A%3Adelegation_fallback_files|any_assignment_reporting_or_control_change_invalidates_captured_attribution|default: that mutates the fallback context, this mutates the workflow author.
fidelity_reason: Production validate_capture with a real WorkflowAuthority value (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:70-122).

behavior: A changed canonical activity revision, input revision, publication issue (Missing/Invalid/Unattributed) or a valid publication identity each fails both validate_capture and publish_recovery, and no parent-fallback file is created.
failure_caught: Publishing a recovery computed against reporting or publication evidence that has since changed, so the frozen evidence does not match the child's actual state.
criticality_reason: The recovery must be rechecked against current canonical evidence at publication, not only at capture (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:320-366).
signal_reason: Six changes each error at validate_capture and again at publish_recovery, with the published name absent (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:560-563).

fidelity_reason: Real files for the publication refusal plus the production validate_capture/publish_recovery pair (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:320-366).
recommendation_reason: Six revisions refused at both capture and publication with no file written.

criticality_reason: validate_capture cross-checks evidence against context fields, not just evidence equality (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:70-122).

recommendation_reason: Six inconsistencies under an equal-evidence precondition.

behavior: An artifact whose context names an unrelated task, a non-empty unresolved list, or a blank deliverable is refused.
failure_caught: Recovery evidence for a different assignment, or an artifact that admits unresolved work, being published as a complete fallback.
criticality_reason: The artifact is the child's substitute result; it must belong to this assignment and claim completeness (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:226-320).
signal_reason: Task mismatch, unresolved list and blank deliverable each error (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:599-607).

behavior: Fallback evidence is refused when the evidence list is empty, when an excerpt says 'Tests passed' but is absent from the inspected bytes, when the same evidence is duplicated to cover a second requirement, when the assessment is blank, and when the child artifact is used as its own independent evidence.
failure_caught: A parent substituting a success assertion for complete independently read evidence, so the recovery claims requirements it never inspected.
criticality_reason: This is the evidence-integration rule: every contract requirement needs an independently read file containing the quoted excerpt (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:226-320).

criticality_reason: The original condition and bytes are part of the frozen evidence and are rechecked at publication (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:124-163, crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:320-366).
signal_reason: Capture validation error, publish error, changed-invalid publish error, removed-file publish error (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:641-660).
uniqueness_reason: The branch at crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:320-366: distinct from nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime%3A%3Adelegation_fallback_files|legacy_brief_without_nonce_and_substituted_exact_bytes_fail_closed|default (brief nonce) and nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime%3A%3Adelegation_fallback_files|frozen_recovery_remains_verifiable_after_mutable_sources_change|default (frozen verification): this covers the original condition drift.
fidelity_reason: Real files with the original rewritten and removed between capture and publication (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:124-163).
recommendation_reason: Four refusal points across capture and publication.

behavior: When the child published a valid result-v1.json, prepare_recovery refuses with 'ordinary collection' and leaves the result bytes untouched.
failure_caught: A fallback replacing or shadowing a valid child publication, so the real result is lost or a substitute is collected.

recommendation_reason: Refusal plus byte preservation of the real result.

criticality_reason: publish_recovery re-runs prepare_recovery under the held fences and requires equality before writing (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:320-366).

recommendation_reason: Five-field TOCTOU matrix with file-absence assertions.

behavior: A published recovery version cannot be reused for changed evidence: prepare with the changed assessment publishes under the same version only after the version is incremented, the first file's bytes stay identical, and a new version gets a new name.
failure_caught: Overwriting an immutable recovery version with different evidence, destroying what the parent previously certified.
criticality_reason: A version maps to exactly one evidence set; republication must be a new version (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:320-366).
signal_reason: Same-version publish error, version 2 yields a different name, and the first file's bytes are unchanged (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:722-726).

fidelity_reason: Real files with the production naming and publish path (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:320-366).

criticality_reason: Evidence references are names inside the assignment directory, and the open-handle Directory must not follow a replaced path (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:32-47, crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_files.rs:33-60).

uniqueness_reason: The branch at crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_files.rs:33-60: distinct from nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime%3A%3Adelegation_fallback_files|success_assertions_cannot_replace_complete_independently_read_evidence|default (evidence content) and the question-side nextest|Test|ovrcr-runtime|server%3A%3Adelegation%3A%3Aquestions%3A%3Atests%3A%3Aheld_directory_prevents_path_replacement_from_redirecting_publication|default (write redirect for questions): this covers fallback evidence names plus the read side.

behavior: A 64 KiB+1 screen, a 32 KiB+1 deliverable, a 64 KiB+1 original and two 70 KiB evidence excerpts are each refused, with the specific 'preservation bound' and 'aggregate' messages for the size cases.

criticality_reason: The bounds protect the durable recovery and the frozen evidence (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:15-18, crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:226-320).

fidelity_reason: Real resized files and constructed captures through the production prepare_recovery (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:226-320).

failure_caught: Historical verification depending on today's mutable files instead of frozen bytes, so a recovery cannot be audited later or a substituted byte passes.
criticality_reason: verify_frozen must use only stored bytes and identity/digests (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:367-400).
signal_reason: verify ok twice before the change, prepare error, substituted evidence error, fabricated original error (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/crates/ovrcr-runtime/tests/delegation_fallback_files.rs:799-810).

fidelity_reason: Real files rewritten after verification, through the production verify_frozen (crates/ovrcr-runtime/src/server/delegation_fallback.rs:367-400).
recommendation_reason: Frozen verification across mutable-source changes with three negatives.
